method: Original insertion/removal and body-head accessors run without instruction interception
comparisons: all body and constraint bytes after every insertion and removal
unrelated head fields and padding preserved
coverage: one through eight records across four distinct bodies
random endpoint orientation and insertion/removal order
limits: Consistent retained rings with distinct valid endpoints; null/self endpoints, duplicate insertion and repeated removal not asserted.
No concurrent synchronization or live lifetime proof.
Provider list removal is separate from endpoint-ring removal.
